description: Use this when you need one sub-account created by the signed-in parent, including its inbox quota and how many inboxes are in use. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: workspace_id (required). Returns {id, name, inbox_quota, inboxes_used, account_id, api_key_prefix, created_at}. Does not return the API key. Another parent's workspace returns 404 workspace_not_found. A sub-account key returns 403 permission_denied. An inbox-scoped key returns 403 permission_denied.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (ws_…) created by this parent account

name: cooper_get_workspace

outputSchema.description: The workspace. The API key is not returned.

api_key.description: Workspace API key, returned only once on create. Never repeat it in full.

api_key_prefix.description: First characters of the workspace key, for display.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

inbox_quota.description: Most inboxes the workspace may hold.

title: Get a sub-account
